description_en: Queries the details of an egress proxy rule group
description_zh: 查询出口规则组详细信息
name: GetEgressProxyRuleGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy rule group
parameters.name: egress_proxy_rule_group_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the egress rule group. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口规则组的创建时间。采用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the egress rule group. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
Description.description_zh: 出口规则组的描述信息。长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）

EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the egress address pool associated with the egress rule group
EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_zh: 出口规则组关联的出口地址池的ID

EgressProxyRuleGroupId.description_en: The ID of the egress rule group

EgressProxyRuleGroupName.description_en: The name of the egress rule group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyRuleGroupName.description_zh: 出口规则组的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

EgressProxyRules.description_en: The list of egress rules. The rules are grouped by effective phase and sorted by priority in ascending order within the same phase
EgressProxyRules.description_zh: 出口规则列表，按生效阶段分组，同一阶段内按优先级（Priority）升序排列

PostResponse.description_en: The list of rules in the PostResponse phase (after the response is returned)
PostResponse.description_zh: PostResponse 阶段（响应返回后）规则列表

items.description_en: The rule in the PostResponse phase

Action.description_en:
The action to perform on the matched traffic after the rule is hit. Valid values:

Allow: allows the traffic that matches the rule.

Deny: blocks the traffic that matches the rule
Action.description_zh:
规则命中后对匹配到的流量执行的动作。取值：

Allow：允许匹配到该规则的流量通过。

Deny：拒绝匹配到该规则的流量

Conditions.description_en: The list of matching conditions for the rule. Each condition consists of a condition key (ConditionKey), an operator (ConditionOperator), and condition values (ConditionValues). The combination of a condition key and an operator must be unique within the same rule
Conditions.description_zh: 规则的匹配条件列表。每个条件由条件键（ConditionKey）、操作符（ConditionOperator）和条件值（ConditionValues）组成，同一规则内条件键与操作符的组合不可重复

ConditionKey.description_en:
The key of the matching condition. The value must match the effective phase (Phase) of the rule and be used with an operator (ConditionOperator) of the corresponding category. Valid values:

request:SourceIp: the source IP address of the request. Used with IP address operators. Supported in the PreDns and PreRequest phases.

request:DestinationDomain: the destination domain name of the request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreDns and PreRequest phases.

request:Http:Uri: the URI of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:Method: the HTTP request method. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:UserAgent: the User-Agent of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:ContentType: the Content-Type of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:Header: the HTTP request header. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase. When you use this key, append the header name to the key in the format of request:Http:Header/<HeaderName>.

request:Protocol: the request protocol. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase
ConditionKey.description_zh:
匹配条件的键。取值需与所在规则的生效阶段（Phase）匹配，并搭配对应类别的操作符（ConditionOperator）使用。取值：

request:SourceIp：请求源 IP，搭配 IP 类操作符使用，支持 PreDns、PreRequest 阶段。

request:DestinationDomain：请求目的域名，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreDns、PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Uri：HTTP 请求的 URI，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Method：HTTP 请求方法，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:UserAgent：HTTP 请求的 User-Agent，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:ContentType：HTTP 请求的 Content-Type，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Header：HTTP 请求头，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段；使用时需在键后追加请求头名称，格式为 request:Http:Header/<HeaderName>。

request:Protocol：请求协议，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段

ConditionOperator.description_en:
The operator of the matching condition. It must be used with a condition key (ConditionKey). Valid values:

StringEquals: exact string match.

StringNotEquals: string mismatch.

StringEqualsIgnoreCase: case-insensitive exact string match.

StringNotEqualsIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string mismatch.

StringPrefixMatch: string prefix match.

StringPrefixMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string prefix match.

StringPrefixNotMatch: string prefix mismatch.

StringPrefixNotMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string prefix mismatch.

StringSuffixMatch: string suffix match.

StringSuffixMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string suffix match.

StringSuffixNotMatch: string suffix mismatch.

StringSuffixNotMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string suffix mismatch.

StringRegexMatch: string regular expression match.

StringRegexNotMatch: string regular expression mismatch.

StringWildcardMatch: string wildcard match.

StringWildcardMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string wildcard match.

StringWildcardNotMatch: string wildcard mismatch.

StringWildcardNotMatchIgnoreCase: case-insensitive string wildcard mismatch.

IpAddress: the source IP address belongs to the specified IP address or CIDR block.

NotIpAddress: the source IP address does not belong to the specified IP address or CIDR block

Status.description_en:
The status of the egress rule group. Valid values:

Provisioning: The rule group is being created.

Available: The rule group is available.

Configuring: The rule group is being reconfigured.

Attaching: The rule group is being attached.

Detaching: The rule group is being detached
Status.description_zh:
出口规则组的状态。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中。

Attaching：绑定中。

Detaching：解绑中

Tags.description_en: The list of tags for the egress rule group
Tags.description_zh: 出口规则组的标签列表

Key.description_en: The tag key. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. It can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
